caseNameFull: The United States, in Error v. Holland-American Line
summary: In error to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit.
attorneys: The■ Attorney General and Mr. Assistant Attorney General Wallace for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Lucius H. Beers for the defendant in error.

opinions.text: Judgment affirmed by an equally divided court, and cause remanded to the District Court of the United States for the Southern District of New York.
